## Run it

**VirtualBox:** import `phorepoc-pc.ova` (File > Import Appliance).

**VMware Workstation Pro or Player:** put `phorepoc-pc.iso` and the unzipped `phorepoc-pc-vmware.zip` (`Phorepoc.vmx`,
`phorepoc-disk.vmdk`) in one folder, open `Phorepoc.vmx` and power it on. The `.ova` is for VirtualBox only.

**QEMU or real hardware:** boot `phorepoc-pc.iso`.

The first boot takes about a minute.
